messages.subject: Request for range finder advice
parts:
I am interested in purchasing range finders for sampling animals from
gazelle fawn size (roughly dog sized) upwards at at least 1000m but have a
limited budget. Does anyone have any advice on models available and whether
they can pick up animals this small at such distances? I am based in the UK
so any advice on UK suppliers would be great (I have been chasing Bushnell
but it appears I can only see some if I buy them first!) Thanks in advance,

Tom Maddox

(Please could you cc. any suggestions to s.du...@ucl.ac.uk)
